title_en: AKPS Seizes Food Supposedly Smuggled Into The Country Using Express Bus
summary_en: BUKIT KAYU HITAM, Nov 12 (Bernama) -- The Bukit Kayu Hitam Border Control and Protection Agency (AKPS) seized 430 kilograms of food products suspected to be being smuggled by express bus.
